hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/probity.sh"; [ -x "$f" ] || { echo "hook missing: $f, so nothing can be judged: refusing. Restart Claude Code from a checkout that exists." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$f"

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/bash-write-guard.sh"; [ -x "$f" ] || { echo "hook missing: $f, so nothing can be guarded: refusing. Restart Claude Code from a checkout that exists." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$f" pre

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/lint-edited-file.sh"; [ -x "$f" ] || { echo "hook missing: $f, so this edit was not linted. Restart Claude Code from a checkout that exists." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$f"

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/bash-write-guard.sh"; [ -x "$f" ] || { echo "hook missing: $f, so this command's writes were not checked. Restart Claude Code from a checkout that exists." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$f" post
